prd.name: BedTerm Release
prd.overview: Everything required to ship BedTerm to the App Store under an individual Apple Developer Program account. Covers developer-account setup, App Store Connect listing assets, legal documents (privacy policy, support page, EULA fallback), in-app privacy disclosures, build signing, and the submission/review workflow. The product itself is not changing here — this PRD tracks the launch readiness work.

requirement.name: Apple Developer Program Enrollment
requirement.description: Enroll the developer in the Apple Developer Program as an individual and verify the account can sign, submit, and publish apps.
requirement.rule: Individual enrollment is purchased and active on the user's Apple ID.
The Apple ID has two-factor authentication enabled.
All Program License Agreements and Paid Apps agreements (if needed) are signed in App Store Connect.
The team appears in Xcode under Signing & Capabilities so Automatic signing can issue certificates.

requirement.name: App Store Connect Record
requirement.description: Create the app record in App Store Connect with the correct bundle ID, primary language, and category, ready to receive builds and metadata.
requirement.rule: Three bundle identifiers, one per configuration, are registered in the developer portal: dev.yjmeqt.bedterm (Release), dev.yjmeqt.bedterm.beta (TestFlight), dev.yjmeqt.bedterm.debug (Debug). All match the Xcode project.
The App Store Connect record exists with name, primary language, bundle ID, and SKU.
Primary and secondary App Store categories are selected (e.g., Developer Tools / Utilities).

requirement.name: Listing Copy and Localization
requirement.description: Marketing copy that appears on the App Store, written in English and localized to the same languages the app supports (zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, ru).
requirement.rule: App name (30 char max) chosen and reserved.
Subtitle (30 char max) written.
Promotional text (170 char max, updatable post-release) drafted.
Long description drafted (4000 char max) emphasising the mobile-keyboard differentiator.
Keyword list (100 char max, comma-separated) drafted.
"What's New" copy drafted for the initial release.
Every above field is translated for zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, ru to match the in-app localizations.

requirement.name: Visual Assets
requirement.description: App icon, screenshots, and (optionally) app preview videos for each required device size.
requirement.rule: 1024×1024 marketing icon produced (no transparency, no rounded corners).
Screenshots for 6.9" iPhone (currently required by App Store Connect) — minimum 3, maximum 10.
Screenshots for 6.5" iPhone if the submission flow asks for them.
Screenshots for 13" iPad if the app declares iPad support.
Screenshots either use language-neutral content or are produced per-locale.

requirement.name: Privacy and Legal Documents
requirement.description: Public-facing privacy policy and support page, plus the App Store Connect privacy questionnaire that mirrors them.
requirement.rule: A privacy policy is published at a stable URL — covers what data the app collects (none, ideally), SSH credential storage in Keychain, and that no analytics is sent.
A support URL is published with contact info and basic help.
Optional marketing URL is published.
App Privacy questionnaire in App Store Connect is completed and matches the privacy policy.
App includes a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declaring required reason API usage (e.g., file timestamp, user defaults) per Apple's 2024+ rules.
Default Apple EULA is used unless a custom EULA is required.

requirement.name: In-App Compliance Strings and Settings
requirement.description: Usage descriptions, encryption export compliance, and age rating answers that must be configured before the binary will pass review.
requirement.rule: Every NS…UsageDescription the app actually triggers is present in InfoPlist.xcstrings with all locales translated.
ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption is set in Info.plist (false if only standard TLS/SSH crypto is used, otherwise the export compliance flow is completed).
Age rating questionnaire is completed in App Store Connect.
"Does your app contain, display, or access third-party content?" answered correctly.

requirement.name: Signing and Build Upload
requirement.description: Produce a signed, archived build that can be uploaded to App Store Connect and distributed via TestFlight before public release.
requirement.rule: Marketing version (e.g. 1.0.0) and build number are set on the target.
A Distribution certificate and App Store provisioning profile exist (Automatic signing is acceptable).
An Xcode Archive of the TestFlight configuration uploads successfully to App Store Connect.
The uploaded build is testable through TestFlight internal testing on the developer's own device.

requirement.name: Submission and Review
requirement.description: Submit the build for App Store review and respond to any review feedback.
requirement.rule: Review notes describe how a reviewer can test the SSH-dependent app (test host credentials, or instructions for using a local sshd).
Demo SSH credentials are supplied to the reviewer if the reviewer cannot otherwise reach a host.
Build is submitted for review.
App passes review and is approved for release.
